acceptance_criteria.criterion: After exact-head candidate admission succeeds for a safe same-repository Draft PR, the trusted controller must perform Draft→Ready using the existing narrow mutation token, then confirm open/non-Draft/exact-head/base/node state by fresh read. Ambiguous mutation without confirmed Ready must fail closed. Merge approval remains separate and manual.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 31 direct candidate-admission tests + 172 related readiness/review wakeup tests pass; Defect Prevention Guard passes. No PAT/new workflow/new authority introduced.

defect_families.evidence: Issue #736 change restores existing trusted Ready mutation only after exact-head/base/fork/node rechecks and confirms resulting state; no merge authority added.
